# Original main BBJ bank and W constructor

The existing `scripts/ci/test-promo-profit-bbj.py` entrypoint runs its 36 focused original-recipient checks and then requires `scripts/ci/test-promo-profit-bbj-financial.py`. The financial runner defaults to the maintained `20261116190221` migration. `--profit-source` supplies an explicit local full migration override and freezes its bytes in the evidence. No work-only default or qualification skip exists.

The financial proof retains the maintained return foundation, its 35 current original owner pins and 31 financial triggers, plus the captured BBJ bank guards. It restores exact current source helpers, receipt/reporting catalogs, standalone indexes and refuse modes. The standalone `(payout_id,user_id)` unique index is necessary to execute the actual recipient owner, not a replacement constraint or journal adapter.

Only the required main100 case, original same-intent replay and late-constructor rollback run here. The original allocator pays A75/B25; the bank remains2900, the wallets175/125, original P50 plus W37.5 gives union87.5, and original fee targets remain200/100. The fault raises XX001 only after observing the original bank debit, recipient wallet credit and real W custody mutation, then checks that all money, journals, payout/recipient records and W state roll back. Existing focused producer checks cover the other receipt, park and lock paths; this is not a mini/park full-bank proof.

The original gift and accepted investment vectors are explicit already-accounted native openings. They do not qualify the accepted-hand producer. Both recipients have exact original hand/club attribution; the original payer must not substitute today's table or home club. The actual W constructor executes and has no money or constructor sink. Notification-only callback adapters perform no financial writes and do not qualify delivery. Existing controlled replica-mode structural openings are not production admin-write-policy qualification.

All JSON files are read-only source/catalog captures, without account rows or credentials. `main-bank-checks.sql` contains the finite numeric, replay and rollback assertions. Evidence retains source hashes and the exact executed core/BBJ SQL. No production connection is made by this runner.
